inputs.modified_text: The Punjab and Haryana High Court has rightly rejected the idea that serious accusations, or the failure to recover stolen articles, are enough to take away someone’s pre-arrest bail. Justice Sumeet Goel said cancellation needs clear proof of misuse of liberty or changed circumstances. That safeguard matters: treating accusation as punishment undermines due process, and the harms of pretrial detention fall hardest on people with the least power and resources. A fair system must demand evidence, not simply severity of allegation.
